segments.mn151:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.mn151:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.mn151:2.1: “Vippasannāni kho te, sāriputta, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.mn151:2.2: Katamena kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharasī”ti?
segments.mn151:2.3: “Suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ, bhante, etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmī”ti.
segments.mn151:2.5: Mahāpurisavihārena kira tvaṃ, sāriputta, etarahi bahulaṃ viharasi.
segments.mn151:2.6: Mahāpurisavihāro eso [hesa (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], sāriputta, yadidaṃ – suññatā.
segments.mn151:3.2: ‘suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ [etarahi bahulaṃ (sī. pī.)] vihareyyan’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn151:3.3: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi nu kho me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti?
segments.mn151:3.4: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:3.5: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:3.6: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:3.7: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, natthi me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:4-8.2: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi nu kho me tattha sotaviññeyyesu saddesu … pe … ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu … jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu … kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu … manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti?
segments.mn151:4-8.7: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:4-8.8: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi me tattha manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:4-8.9: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:4-8.10: ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, natthi me tattha manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:9.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:9.4: ‘appahīnā kho me pañca kāmaguṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:9.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:9.6: ‘pahīnā kho me pañca kāmaguṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:10.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:10.4: ‘appahīnā kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:10.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:10.6: ‘pahīnā kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:11.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:11.4: ‘apariññātā kho me pañcupādānakkhandhā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ pariññāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:11.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:11.6: ‘pariññātā kho me pañcupādānakkhandhā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:12.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:12.4: ‘abhāvitā kho me cattāro satipaṭṭhānā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:12.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:12.6: ‘bhāvitā kho me cattāro satipaṭṭhānā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:13.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:13.4: ‘abhāvitā kho me cattāro sammappadhānā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:13.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:13.6: ‘bhāvitā kho me cattāro sammappadhānā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:14.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:14.4: ‘abhāvitā kho me cattāro iddhipādā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:14.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:14.6: ‘bhāvitā kho me cattāro iddhipādā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:15.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:15.4: ‘abhāvitāni kho me pañcindriyānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:15.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:15.6: ‘bhāvitāni kho me pañcindriyānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:16.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:16.4: ‘abhāvitāni kho me pañca balānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:16.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:16.6: ‘bhāvitāni kho me pañca balānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:17.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:17.4: ‘abhāvitā kho me satta bojjhaṅgā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:17.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:17.6: ‘bhāvitā kho me satta bojjhaṅgā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:18.2: ‘bhāvito nu kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti?
segments.mn151:18.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:18.4: ‘abhāvito kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:18.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:18.6: ‘bhāvito kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:19.2: ‘bhāvitā nu kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti?
segments.mn151:19.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:19.4: ‘abhāvitā kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā samathavipassanānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:19.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:19.6: ‘bhāvitā kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:20.2: ‘sacchikatā nu kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti?
segments.mn151:20.3: Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:20.4: ‘asacchikatā kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā vijjāya vimuttiyā sacchikiriyāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn151:20.5: Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn151:20.6: ‘sacchikatā kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn151:21.1: “Ye hi keci, sāriputta, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhesuṃ, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhesuṃ.
segments.mn151:21.2: Yepi hi keci, sāriputta, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessanti, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessanti.
segments.mn151:21.3: Yepi hi keci, sāriputta, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhenti, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhenti.
segments.mn151:21.4: Tasmātiha, sāriputta [vo sāriputta evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ (sī. pī.)],‘paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessāmā’ti – evañhi vo, sāriputta, sikkhitabban”ti.
segments.mn151:21.7: Attamano āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Phalasamāpattito hi vuṭṭhitassa pañcahi pasādehi patiṭṭhitokāso vippasanno hoti, chavivaṇṇo parisuddho.

Yena cāhaṃ maggenātiādīsu vihārato paṭṭhāya yāva gāmassa indakhīlā esa paviṭṭhamaggo nāma, antogāmaṃ pavisitvā gehapaṭipāṭiyā caritvā yāva nagaradvārena nikkhamanā esa caritabbapadeso nāma, bahi indakhīlato paṭṭhāya yāva vihārā esa paṭikkantamaggo nāma.
Paṭighaṃ vāpi cetasoti citte paṭihaññanakilesajātaṃ kiñci atthi natthīti.
Pahīnā nu kho me pañca kāmaguṇātiādīsu ekabhikkhussa paccavekkhaṇā nānā, nānābhikkhūnaṃ paccavekkhaṇā nānāti.
Eko hi bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā vivittokāse nisinno paccavekkhati “pahīnā nu kho me pañcakāmaguṇā”ti.
So “appahīnā”ti ñatvā vīriyaṃ paggayha anāgāmimaggena pañcakāmaguṇikarāgaṃ samugghāṭetvā maggānantaraṃ phalaṃ phalānantaraṃ maggaṃ tato vuṭṭhāya paccavekkhanto “pahīnā”ti pajānāti.
Etesaṃ pana arahattamaggena pahānādīni honti, evaṃ ekabhikkhussa nānāpaccavekkhaṇā hoti.
Etāsu pana paccavekkhaṇāsu añño bhikkhu ekaṃ paccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati, añño ekanti evaṃ nānābhikkhūnaṃ nānāpaccavekkhaṇā hoti.

lines: Nanu tāni indriyāni sabhāvato vippasannāni hontīti?
Na hidaṃ tādisaṃ pasannataṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, idaṃ pana santapaṇītasamāpattisamuṭṭhitānaṃ paccupaṭṭhitānaṃ cittajarūpānaṃ vasena sesatisantatirūpānaṃ seṭṭhataraṃ paṇītabhāvāpattiṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Vihārato paṭṭhāyāti parikkhitte ca vihāre parikkhepato paṭṭhāya, aparikkhitte ca parikkhepārahaṭṭhānato paṭṭhāya.
Ārammaṇe paṭihaññanākārena pavattamānampi paṭighasampayuttaṃ citte paṭihanantaṃ viya pavattatīti āha –
Divasañca rattiñca anusikkhantenāti etaṃyeva rāgādippahāyiniṃ sammāpaṭipattiṃ divā ca rattiñca anu anu sikkhantena uparūpari vaḍḍhentena.
Pahīnā nu kho me pañca kāmaguṇāti ettha kāmaguṇappahānaṃ nāma tappaṭibaddhachandarāgappahānaṃ.
“tiṭṭhanti citrāni tatheva loke, athettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan”ti.
Ekabhikkhussa paccavekkhaṇā nānāti ekasseva bhikkhuno,“pahīnā nu kho me pañca kāmaguṇā”tiādinā pāḷiyaṃ āgatā nānāpaccavekkhaṇā honti.
Idāni tameva saṅkhepato vuttamatthaṃ vitthārato dassetuṃ,“kathan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha “paccavekkhatī”ti vuttaṃ, kathaṃ pana paccavekkhatīti āha “pahīnā nu kho”tiādi.

Phalānantaraṃ magganti tasmiṃ anāgāmimagge ṭhito phalasamāpattito vuṭṭhāya aggamaggatthāya vipassanaṃ ārabhitvā tasmiṃyeva āsane na cireneva vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahattamaggaṃ gaṇhanto nirodhadhammānuppattiyā vipassanāparivāsābhāvato phalānantaraṃ maggappatto nāma hotīti katvā.

lines: Dhammasenāpatino paṭisallīyanassa adhippetattā, upari ca pāḷiyaṃ,“suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ, bhante, etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmī”ti (ma. ni.3.438) vuttattā “paṭisallānāti phalasamāpattito”ti āha.
